scope: 26 people from member and alumni records; all 66 currently listed publications; career-wide member honors including work outside the lab.
method: Read personal sites and available CVs; name/award/news searches and Twitter/X searches across roster; exact-title award searches across publications; keyword checks on canonical publication pages with personal/conference/institutional follow-up for positive claims.
limits: Twitter/X timelines were inaccessible. Search snippets or reposts do not count as a complete Twitter review.
26 publication-page attempts failed or returned a browser challenge. Title searches and author/institution evidence were used as fallback; those pages remain gaps.
A readable-page keyword check is not a complete historical publisher audit; absence of award text is not proof that a paper never received an award.
The 66-paper scope is the website corpus; this is not a claim to inspect every paper ever written by all members.
Personal CV claims, indexed-only leads, conflicts, missing years and outside-lab work remain distinguishable. Nothing from this expanded audit has been added to public content.
